plan.architecture_flow: Scanner → XML Parser → Raw Observations → Transforms → Enriched Observations → Analysis → Sinks
plan.overview: Redesign the scanning pipeline so that each scanner handles its own XML output parsing, with proper data flow through transforms → analysis → sinks. Both nmap and masscan will output XML (`-oX` flag) that gets parsed into comprehensive observations.

1_XML_Storage_Queue_Management.Cleanup: Remove XML files after successful processing
1_XML_Storage_Queue_Management.Queue_System: Filesystem-based queue for scan results awaiting processing
1_XML_Storage_Queue_Management.XML_Files: Store in src-tauri/.scans/ directory with UUID names

utils/masscan_stream.rs: Use masscan with -oX output.xml + real-time JSON output
Parse XML for detailed service/banner information
Create Service observations with enhanced data
utils/nmap_stream.rs: Use nmap with -oX output.xml + verbose stdout for progress
Parse XML using Host.rs, Service.rs, Port.rs, Session.rs
Emit Host/Service/Port observations with all fields
Handle nmap scripts and vulnerability detection

IpEnrichmentTransform: Extract IPs, MACs, vendors from host observations
ScriptAnalysisTransform: Process nmap script results using Script.rs
ServiceParsingTransform: Parse service banners using Service.rs patterns

DbSink: Store host data (MAC, vendor, OS, uptime, distance)
Enhanced service storage with banners, CPE, confidence
Vulnerability storage with CVE details and exploits
UiSink: Emit host events with all parsed fields
Rich service events with version/banner info
Vulnerability events with severity and exploit data

Host.rs: Comprehensive host info (MAC, vendor, hostname, OS, uptime, distance)

Phase_1_XML_Parser_Integration: Create utils/xml_parsers.rs with Host, Service, Port, Session structs
Update scanners to output XML + progress
Phase_2_Transform_Enhancement: Add script analysis and vulnerability parsing
Implement service fingerprinting and CPE extraction
Phase_4_Sink_Improvements: Enhance DB schema for comprehensive data
Update UI events with rich info
Phase_5_Testing_Integration: End-to-end testing of XML → observations → UI
Verify all host fields display properly
Test vulnerability detection and exploit correlation

Benefits: Separation of Concerns: each scanner handles XML parsing
Extensibility: easy to add new scanners/modules
Performance: efficient batch processing and DB ops

plan.title: LEGION2 XML Pipeline Architecture Redesign
